title: viola tricolor subsp. parvula
intro: Viola tricolor subsp. parvula, commonly known as wild pansy, is a plant species in the Violaceae family that is native to Europe. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation and promote wound healing, which suggests its therapeutic actions may include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects. The bioactive constituents of Viola tricolor subsp. parvula include flavonoids, anthocyanins, and alkaloids, which may contribute to its medicinal properties. Further research is needed to fully understand the plant's health benefits and therapeutic actions, but it has been traditionally used to support respiratory health and as a treatment for various skin conditions.
